fallback_order: Dhan Data API for fields it documents and returns
Official NSE/BSE/RBI/SEBI/CDSL or underlying-provider free archives
Other free/open data APIs with documented schema and acceptable use terms
GitHub/Kaggle/Hugging Face/community caches only after dataset/license/provenance review
Composite source panel with source_id, available_at, observed_at, retrieval/version and hashes preserved
continuation_rules.when_all_sources_for_a_family_fail: Mark only that feature family or candidate cell NOT_ESTIMABLE/BLOCKED_DATA, record attempts/errors, and continue all other families/phases.
continuation_rules.missing_values: Keep missingness explicit, do not replace missing prices/OI/news with zero, do not interpolate option prices, and do not silently forward-fill beyond the pre-registered availability rule.
continuation_rules.phase_completion: A phase can finish with explicit feature-family limitations; unavailable fields are not a global stop condition.
permitted_technical_stops: A secret is about to be exposed
A request exceeds approved size/rate/endpoint scope
A schema/temporal/leakage defect makes the affected artifact unsafe to parse
A required governance or independent tester gate has not been passed

source_specific_limits.dhan_daily_candles: Provider docs: daily candles back to instrument inception; split large downloads by deterministic calendar-year chunks when needed.
source_specific_limits.dhan_intraday_candles: Provider docs: up to 5 years; intervals 1, 5, 15, 25, 60 minutes; maximum 90 days per request.
source_specific_limits.dhan_expired_options: Provider docs: up to 5 years of rolling strike-relative expired option data; 1, 5, 15, 25, 60 minutes; maximum 30 days per request; OHLC, IV, volume, OI, strike and spot fields.
source_specific_limits.dhan_rate_limit: Provider docs list Data API rate limits of 5 requests/second and 100,000/day; implement a safer serial limit, checkpointing and resumable shards.

research_boundaries.future_holdout: Use the tester-approved prospective holdout design only after the real freeze manifest and official session calendar are committed before any holdout label release.

execution_gate.reason_live_requests_not_yet_authorized: This policy changes how unavailable sources are handled; it is not the exact source-by-source request manifest required for the next Dhan/open-source bulk acquisition run.

authoritative_cache_hierarchy: Git data/cache committed raw/normalized chunks when license and size permit
repository-controlled GitHub Release assets or approved Git LFS for larger redistributable immutable shards, catalogue committed to Git
metadata-only provenance when source terms prohibit persistent payload storage
GitHub Actions artifacts are temporary diagnostics, not authoritative cache

intraday_index.window: 2021-10-11 through 2026-10-10, last inclusive session date before API toDate boundary

rolling_options.window: 2021-10-11 through 2026-10-10, with toDate exclusive date windows
rolling_options.greeks_policy: Dhan historical rolling-option data do not contain historical Greeks. Prefer point-in-time sourced expiry calendar, risk-free rate and dividend-yield inputs for Black-Scholes-European-v1 Greeks. If one or more auxiliary inputs are missing, preserve raw/IV data and calculate only clearly labelled proxy Greeks using rule-derived NIFTY expiry dates and explicit zero-rate/zero-dividend assumptions; record expiry_mapping_source, risk_free_rate_source, dividend_yield_source, greek_assumption and greek_status=CALCULATED_BS_V1_PROXY_INPUTS. If expiry cannot be mapped, Greeks stay null with a reason code. Do not copy current option-chain Greeks backward or describe proxy values as provider-supplied.

acquisition_budget_contract.scope_rule: Exact manifest enumerates every planned request key; no implicit Cartesian expansion. Retry only once per request for manifest-approved transient timeout/HTTP 429/5xx and only within the cumulative 100-retry and 8,701-wire-request caps.
